scheme1_name: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme for Single Girl Child (SGC)
scheme2_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Encourage meritorious single girl students to continue studies in classes 11-12
comparisons.scheme2_value: Provide free food grains to poor and migrant families, especially during/after COVID-19
Free food grains (5 kg per person per month, in addition to subsidised PDS ration)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Single girl child of parents; 70%+ marks in CBSE class 10; studying in class 11-12 in CBSE-affiliated school; family income ≤ Rs. 8 lakh/year; school fee ≤ Rs. 2,500/month (class 10) or ≤ Rs. 3,000/month (classes 11-12)
comparisons.scheme2_value: Families with AAY (Antyodaya Anna Yojana) or PHH (Priority Household) ration cards; includes widows, disabled, elderly 60+, landless labourers, slum dwellers, BPL families, primitive tribal households

comparisons.scheme1_value: School students only (classes 11-12); single girl children; Indian nationals
comparisons.scheme2_value: All household members in eligible AAY/PHH ration-card families (no age limit)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Aadhaar card, class 10 mark sheet, school admission proof, student ID, photo, signature, bank account details, fee receipt (verified by principal), income affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper (attested by Gazetted Officer/SDM/First-Class Magistrate)
comparisons.scheme2_value: Ration Card; Aadhaar Card (if seeded with Ration Card) — minimal documentation

comparisons.scheme1_value: Online via CBSE website (cbse.gov.in/cbsenew/scholar.html): register, fill form, upload scanned undertaking and affidavit (max 1 MB PDFs); print confirmation page; renewals require courier of signed confirmation to CBSE Delhi office
comparisons.scheme2_value: No separate application. Visit nearest Fair Price Shop with Ration Card; quote card number or Aadhaar; authenticate via Aadhaar fingerprint/iris; collect grain immediately

comparisons.scheme1_value: Application windows notified yearly on CBSE scholarship page; must apply before deadline; benefit valid for max 2 years (classes 11-12) subject to renewal with class 11 mark sheet
comparisons.scheme2_value: No deadline; distribution is ongoing monthly through Fair Price Shops; no renewal required

comparisons.scheme1_value: School fee > Rs. 2,500/month (class 10) or > Rs. 3,000/month (classes 11-12) disqualifies; family income > Rs. 8 lakh/year disqualifies; twins/triplets born together count as 'single girl child' (only one eligible); must maintain good conduct and regular attendance; only CBSE-affiliated schools
comparisons.scheme2_value: General ration-card holders are NOT eligible — must be AAY or PHH category; grain type (wheat vs. rice) depends on State/UT allocation

comparisons.scheme1_value: Direct transfer via ECS/NEFT to Aadhaar-linked bank account; Rs. 1,000 per month
comparisons.scheme2_value: Direct collection of food grains from Fair Price Shop; no money involved

comparisons.scheme1_value: Renewal needed for class 12; requires class 11 mark sheet; good conduct and regular attendance mandatory; application must be school-verified
comparisons.scheme2_value: No renewal process; same family remains eligible as long as ration-card category (AAY/PHH) is maintained
All-India; One Nation One Ration Card allows beneficiaries to draw rations in any State/UT

comparisons.scheme2_value: Ministry of Finance via Department of Food & Public Distribution

⚠️ **AI Guidance Disclaimer**: This comparison is based on official scheme documents and is NOT an official notification. Verify all details with official sources before applying.

**These schemes serve completely different needs:**

1. **Choose CBSE SGC Scholarship if**: You are a single girl child in class 11-12 studying in a CBSE school, scored 70%+ in class 10, and your family income is ≤ Rs. 8 lakh/year. This provides monthly cash support for your education.

2. **Choose PMGKAY if**: Your family has an AAY or PHH ration card (not a general card). This provides free food grains monthly, regardless of income, targeting the poorest households.

**Can you apply for both?** Yes! They are independent schemes with different criteria. A single girl student from a poor family could potentially benefit from both.

**Next Steps**: 
- **For CBSE SGC**: Visit https://www.cbse.gov.in/cbsenew/scholar.html and check current application window dates.
- **For PMGKAY**: Visit https://nfsa.gov.in or contact your State Food & Public Distribution department to check if your ration card is AAY/PHH category.
- Contact your school principal or local Fair Price Shop for clarification on your eligibility.
